method: Before/after/after/before. 16 drags per rate/version; three simultaneous viewers per drag. Stages overlap. All successful samples retained, including cold first moves.

trials.method: Eight real Legacy player drags per CPU rate, with simultaneous 2D and 3D DM clients in Player visibility. All assisted, same disposable courtyard and final client build for both server versions. 140 monsters, 48 fixed lights, 28 wall segments, carried lantern, heavy darkness and remembered terrain. All three browser CPUs throttled after startup; unrestricted server on same host. Legacy WebGL blocked, standard modes real GPU, Low. Missing LFS models use test stand-ins. No video/trace, WAN latency, RAM or GPU restriction. First-paint estimate uses two RAF opportunities. Server stages overlap.
